==Biography==
===Early Years===
Mykhailo "'''Kira'''" Harmash was born in Mariupol, Ukraine, in the Donetsk region. He began to play video games at the age of 4. Kira earned his first $500 prize for 3rd place at III Season Star Ladder ''Bloodline Champions'' in 2012 as a member of the team '''Going Bonkers'''. Kira initially started ''League of Legends'' as a support player in 2011, and became known on the EUW server an Anivia main.
===2014 Season===
Kira got his competitive start with [[Carpe Diem]] in the [[SLTV_StarSeries/Season_I|Season I SLTV StarSeries]]. They claimed third place in the regular season with a 8-3 series record, what received them a spot in the playoffs. They fell into loser's bracket after lost 1-2 to [[Internationally V|Revival Dragons]] in the first round and swept both [[Good Team Multigaming]] and [[Internationally V|Revival Dragons]] 2-0 there, making to the finals,  where they beat the [[Dragon Team]] 3-2.
===2016 Preseason===
Kira was the fan-voted mid laner to attended [[International Wildcard All-Star Melbourne 2015|IWCA Melbourne]] representing the CIS region. The [[Team CIS|CIS team]] placed second in the 5v5 regional tournament, losing to [[Team Turkey]] in the finals; however, because Kira won the 1v1 tournament, he gave his team enough points that they won the tournament overall to attend the main [[All-Star Los Angeles 2015|All-Star Event]] in Los Angeles.

== Trivia ==
* Favorite anime is ''[[wikipedia:en:Bakuman|Bakuman]]''.
* Enjoys playing the guitar.
* His first main was {{ci|Anivia}}.
* Played [[LCL/2017_Season/Summer_Season/Player_Statistics|14 unique champions across 14 games during the regular season in 2017 Summer]], losing only one match on {{ci|Viktor}}.
* Studied Russian literature in university.
* Married and has a daughter with his wife.
* Was nicknamed "vida loka" (''thug life'') by the Brazilian community for his aggressive playstyle.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
